concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 0 – Setup & Synthetic Video Generation (lines describing compute **CPU Farneback optical flow** for each pair)
concerns.text: FR‑006 requires the pipeline to operate on CPU‑only resources *using pre‑computed optical‑flow features*, yet Phase 0 computes Farneback optical flow on‑the‑fly for each newly generated counterfactual video. This internal contradiction makes the feasibility claim unsound and may cause the pipeline to exceed the 6 h wall‑clock limit on the free‑tier runner.

concerns.location: research.md: Training runs for **10 random seeds** (section ‘Model & Loss’) and spec.md: no power analysis
concerns.text: The plan provides no power analysis or justification that 10 seeds and N = 200 synthetic videos are sufficient to detect the expected reduction in ΔAcc. Without an a‑priori effect‑size estimate, the study may be under‑powered, risking false‑negative conclusions.

concerns.location: plan.md: Phase 0 – Synthetic video generation and counterfactual creation (lines describing deterministic procedural generator and object‑swap)
concerns.text: Using the same deterministic procedural generator for both original and counterfactual videos can introduce hidden correlations between motion patterns and object identity. The plan does not describe any control (e.g., randomizing motion trajectories independently of object class) to rule out this confound, threatening construct validity of the ΔAcc metric as a pure measure of motion reliance.
